ValidationRule.description: End User Customer (Channel_Partner__c) must be an End Customer account whose Parent = the Opportunity Account. Enforced on create/change only, so unrelated automation (quote sync/revise) is not blocked by pre-existing data.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND( OR(ISNEW(), ISCHANGED(Channel_Partner__c)), NOT(ISBLANK(Channel_Partner__c)), OR( Channel_Partner__r.RecordType.DeveloperName <> "End_Customer", Channel_Partner__r.ParentId <> AccountId ) )
ValidationRule.errorMessage: The End User Customer must be an End Customer account whose Parent Account is this Opportunity's Account.
